risk.title: Risk — watchlist (last 252 sessions)
risk.source: Computed from Yahoo Finance adjusted closes; risk-free: 3-month US Treasury (US), ECB deposit rate (EU)
risk.defs: Daily log returns r = ln(Pt/Pt-1) on adjusted closes. Vol = std(r) × √252. Return = mean(r) × 252. Sharpe = (Return − risk-free) / Vol, risk-free = 3-month US Treasury (DGS3MO) for US or ECB deposit rate (Europe). Beta = cov(r, r index) / var(r index), index = SPY (US) or Euro Stoxx 50 (Europe). Max drawdown = largest peak-to-trough decline.
risk.need2: At least 2 tickers with history are needed in the watchlist.
val.title: Cross-check
val.note: Independent recomputation (plain Python, separate yfinance call) of the latest price and 1-year volatility.
news.title: News & sentiment
news.method: Sentiment by FinBERT (ProsusAI/finbert) on the original English headline. Average: positive = +1, neutral = 0, negative = −1. In French mode, English headlines are machine-translated (Helsinki-NLP opus-mt-tc-big-en-fr), can be turned off in settings.

esef.title: Official annual report (ESEF)

comps.empty: No company of this sector has a loaded page yet.
comps.note: Multiples computed by Atlas in euros: market cap = last delayed price × shares; enterprise value = market cap + net debt; denominators = last reported fiscal year (Yahoo Finance). P/E and EV/EBITDA not computed when earnings or EBITDA are negative. Converted at today's Yahoo FX rates. Sectors as classified by Yahoo.
deals.none_sec: No such filing recently (only SEC filers are covered).
deals.sec_note: SEC forms: 8-K item 1.01 (material agreement) or 2.01 (completed acquisition/disposal), 13D (stake > 5% with intentions), tender offers (SC TO), mergers (S-4, F-4, DEFM14A, 425). US companies and European companies listed in the US only.
deals.news_note: Automatic detection of words such as 'acquisition', 'takeover', 'merger', 'divest' in headlines: false positives are possible. Share buybacks are excluded.
def.vol: How much the price moves: standard deviation of daily returns × √252. 30% = very volatile, 15% = fairly stable.
def.ret: Average daily (log) return × 252: the year's trend expressed per year.
def.perf1y: Change between the last close and the close 252 sessions earlier (about one trading year).
def.sharpe: (Return − risk-free rate) / volatility: return per unit of risk. Above 1 is good; negative = worse than a risk-free investment.
def.beta: Sensitivity to the market: 1.5 = the stock moves on average 1.5× the index; 0.5 = half. Index: S&P 500 (US), Euro Stoxx 50 (European large caps), STOXX Europe 600 (small & mid caps).
def.mdd: Largest fall from a peak to a trough over the period: the worst loss for an investor who bought at the top.
def.rf: Return on a riskless investment: 3-month US Treasury bill for US stocks, ECB deposit rate for Europe.
def.size: Large cap ≥ €10bn, mid cap €2–10bn, small cap < €2bn (market cap converted into euros).
def.mcap: Stock-market value of all shares: price × number of shares, converted into euros.
def.ev: Market cap + net debt: what buying the whole company would cost, debt included. The basis of M&A multiples.
def.pe: Market cap / net income (or price / EPS): how many years of earnings you pay. 15x = 15 years of current earnings.
def.pe_fwd: Price / EPS expected by analysts for the next 12 months (Yahoo's calculation).
def.ev_ebitda: Enterprise value / EBITDA: the reference M&A multiple to compare companies regardless of their debt.
def.ev_sales: Enterprise value / revenue: useful for companies with little or no profit.
def.pb: Market cap / book equity: above 1, the market values the company above its accounts.
def.ebitda: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation: a proxy for cash generated by operations.
def.ebit_margin: Operating profit (EBIT) / revenue: profitability of the business before financing costs and taxes.
def.net_margin: Net income / revenue: what is left for shareholders out of 100 of sales.
def.growth: Change versus the previous year's fiscal year (or quarter).
def.eps: Net income divided by the number of shares (diluted: including shares that could be created).
def.eps_est: Average EPS forecast of the analysts covering the company.
def.rev_est: Average revenue forecast of the analysts.
def.n_analysts: Analysts whose forecasts make up the consensus. Fewer than 3: not very reliable.
def.surprise: Gap between reported EPS and analysts' expected EPS. Positive = better than expected.
def.target: Price analysts think is reachable within 12 months (average of targets).
def.reco: Analysts' opinion: buy, hold or sell. Average published by Yahoo Finance.
def.fcf: Operating cash flow − capital expenditure: the cash actually available (dividends, debt reduction, acquisitions).
def.net_debt: Financial debt − cash. Negative = the company has more cash than debt.
def.nd_ebitda: Years of EBITDA needed to repay net debt. Above 3x, leverage is high; a key LBO criterion.
def.roe: Net income / equity: return on shareholders' money.
def.fy: 12-month accounting period used for the multiples (the last reported one).
def.next_earnings: Date of the next results release, announced by the company or estimated.
def.corr: From −1 to +1: +1 = the two stocks move together, 0 = no link, −1 = they move in opposite directions.
def.ma: Average closing price of the last 50 or 200 sessions: smooths the chart to show the trend.

help.title: Function directory
help.syntax:
Security: MC FP Equity, AAPL US Equity, SX5E Index, EURUSD Curncy, CO1 Comdty — or just a name (lvmh, total) or a ticker (TTE, MC.PA).
Then the function: MC FP DES, MC FP ANR. A function alone (GP, DES) applies to the current security.
Yellow keys EQUITY / INDEX / CRNCY / CMDTY (or F8, F10, F11, F9) add the security type and run. GO (Enter) runs. MENU (Esc on an empty line) goes back to the previous screen. HELP (F1) opens this page.
Numbers: 3 GO jumps to panel 3 of the screen; 95 to 99 run the red buttons (my list, export, comparison, settings, help).

fn.MKTS: Monitor: my list, indices, FX, macro

fn.QUOTE: Price chart (GP) with moving averages and volume
